correctness.rationale: Exponential normalization yields uniform simplex volume and independent Laplace contrasts; the Monge chamber is one of q! equally likely strict orders, recovering the known volume. Conditioning on a coordinate-zero simplex face changes the selected contrast CDF to uniform (0,1/2) or (1/2,1), giving exact incomplete beta/binomial tails and correct intrinsic simplex face-height h_q. For a comparison slack g_i the intrinsic gradient has length 2; one-sided coarea applied before exponential normalization yields A(W_i)/V=2q E[f(Z_(i))(q+sum_{j=1}^{q-1}|Zj|+|Z_(i)|)], with S conditional mean q+sum|D|. Summing over sorted Laplace Z and using E f(Z)=1/4, E|Z|f(Z)=1/8 and E|Z|=1 gives exact q(q-1)(2q-1)/2. Order-statistic quantile convergence gives f(Z_(i))→min(u,1-u) and resulting triangular factor 4; binomial CLT gives the centered Gaussian coordinate profile. Independently checked exact coordinate complementarity and aggregate coarea sum for every q=2..100, independent of repository code. The published volume is not reclassified as a novel fact.

final_claim: For every q>=2 standard intrinsic-Euclidean normalized nonnegative two-row Monge polytope, individual coordinate-facet areas equal binomial tail weights, the comparison-facet area sum/V equals q(q-1)(2q-1)/2, total surface/volume is closed-form, comparison walls carry 1-4/q+O(q^-2) of area, and bulk comparison/central coordinate profiles are triangular/Gaussian.
limitations: Only 2×q orientation with sum=1 and intrinsic Euclidean metric; higher-row Monge surfaces not claimed.
